fastQuotes.name: aio-screener-data-plane
fastQuotes.consumerGate: public-config.json marketData.fastQuotes.enabled is derived from this flag plus the measured soak and the live coverage probe (scripts/ci-fast-plane-consumer-gate.mjs)

relay.name: aio-proxy
relay.boundary: upstream-host-is-hardcoded; client never supplies a destination; FRED personal header requires opt-in and is neither logged nor cached; BOK/KOSIS use operator secrets

proxyQuotaContract.operatorUsage: GET /_ops/ai-usage; separate AIO_OPERATOR_TOKEN; no CORS; no-store; never add counts or AI cap to public /health
proxyQuotaContract.budgetScope: browser chat, translation and Actions analysis share one UTC-month $10 reservation ledger; paid AI search is disabled
proxyQuotaContract.automationAuthentication: origin-less POST /openai requires X-AIO-Automation-Token; not a public browser credential
proxyQuotaContract.developmentOrigins: explicit exact http://localhost:<port> or http://127.0.0.1:<port> values in AIO_DEV_ORIGINS
